title: Navimower 0.4.1-beta4

## MQTT pose-stream stability

Field diagnostics from an H1500 showed a repeatable vendor-side failure mode: the MQTT broker/SDK remained connected while `realtimeDate/location` type=1 pose packets disappeared or arrived in bursts. The previous watchdog treated missing pose as a reason to rebuild the complete MQTT client, causing several rebuilds within tens of seconds without restoring the vendor pose publisher.

- Missing/stale type=1 pose now enters **`pose_degraded`** instead of rebuilding the MQTT client.
- The integration performs a location-topic re-subscribe, then waits 120 seconds before trying another pose re-subscribe.
- Private-cloud position fallback continues while pose is degraded. Useful MQTT state/progress traffic is preserved.
- Full SDK rebuild is no longer triggered solely by missing/stale pose. Real broker disconnect handling remains separate.
- `last_any_message_age_s` is now current-device scoped on shared accounts, so other mowers cannot make the selected mower look alive.
- Diagnostics add `pose_resubscribe_count` and `last_any_message_scope`.

Beta3 raw-first telemetry behaviour is unchanged.

This is a prerelease for field validation before stable 0.4.1.
